structured.approach:
I loaded the requirement-steps procedure for REQ-01. I read the five contracted inputs (roadmap, regulatory sources, connector inventory, model dependency map, decision log), the ticket (record:intake) and its GitHub source file, requirements/ZD-48600.md. I also read the earlier REQ-01 attempt's evaluation: its only automated failures were citations to related requirement files that it never read. So this time I read ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455 before citing them.

Neither the Pre Backlog sheet nor the DevOps board was in context. Instead I searched the requirements/ intake files and the trace ledger for duplicates. I found three related open items but no duplicate.

I split the ticket word for word into CR-0 to CR-7 and linked the entry to roadmap item R-AP-12. I checked it against decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and lessons L-007 and L-011, and found no conflict. I ran the regulatory, connector and model-dependency checks against the inputs. The connector inventory covers only the ap_aging library, not the vendor feed change, so I raised that gap as an open question. Gaps are recorded as labelled assumptions (A-1 to A-6) and non-blocking open questions (Q-1 to Q-5). Shell use is denied in this step, so I used only Read, Glob, Grep and Write.

claims.text: Intake ZD-48600 came in through the Customer Feedback channel on 2026-10-24 as Zendesk ticket ZD-48600 (sample, synthetic). Its source link is hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md.

The ticket has change requests for ap_pipeline (optional paid_date column, delays_by_vendor), ap_forecast (vendor_risk, optional risk argument on build_explanation_request), ap_aging (overdue_with_risk) and ap_portal (renderOverdueRisk). It also requires an end-to-end proof: feed -> delays -> risk -> overdue list -> portal table.

The entry is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12, 'give AP managers earlier visibility of overdue payables' (Q4 2026 roadmap, AP module, owner PM). It is not linked to R-AP-14 (aging export for finance close).
No regulatory source applies to this change, so no rule is changed or new.
The connector inventory states only that no source-system connector is affected by the ap_aging library. The vendor feed v3 change (new optional paid_date column) is not covered by it.

ap_forecast uses provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, for the payment-delay explanation, and the optional risk argument changes the prompt sent to it. vendor_risk uses no LLM; it is a rule on the predicted delay.
No conflict with prior decisions: the overdue list covers only unpaid invoices (D-2026-050), amounts are Decimal (D-2026-044), and day counts are assumed to be calendar days (D-2026-031).
Lesson L-007 applies: the 'more than 30 days past due' rule and the vendor_risk thresholds (> 30, > 10) need explicit boundary tests.
Open item ZD-48501 uses the same rule, 'unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due', for overdue_summary in ap_aging.
Open item ZD-48211 asks to flag open invoices more than 30 days past their due date as overdue, and says paid invoices should never count as overdue.
Open item ZD-48455 uses 'overdue risk' wording for ap_portal aging rows, with class row-overdue. That is a different table and class from overdue-risk / risk-RISK.
The source item's risk map says there is no finance posting, authentication, tenancy or payment execution in this change, the tier is T2, and the risk label is advisory only.

open_questions: Q-1: The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not available, so the duplicate check covered only the requirements/ intake files. Can the PM confirm no board item already covers this? Should one overdue definition be shared with ZD-48501 and ZD-48211? REQ-02 decides any merge.
Q-2: Is the vendor feed (feed v3, new paid_date column) a registered source-system connector that needs an inventory entry or version update? The current inventory mentions only the ap_aging library.
Q-3: Who sends the intake notification for this entry (spine or PM), and to whom?
Q-4: Should an unpaid row that carries a paid_date be rejected, or should the date be ignored? The ticket only defines rejection for an invalid paid_date.
Q-5: Should renderOverdueRisk HTML-escape the vendor names and ids it renders?
structured.summary: I wrote feat.intake (the verbatim ticket with its source link, split into change requests CR-0 to CR-7) and feat.prebacklog (a draft pre-backlog entry linked to R-AP-12 under trace FEAT-ZD-48600). No regulatory source applies. The LLM change is a prompt change only (acme-text-2 is unchanged). There is no conflict with D-2026-031, D-2026-044 or D-2026-050. Three related open items (ZD-48211, ZD-48501, ZD-48455) go to REQ-02 for grouping. The connector inventory does not cover the vendor feed change; this is raised as Q-2. Six assumptions and five non-blocking questions are left for the PM gate. Nothing blocks the step.
